quand: As soon as someone signs up to the letter: clicking the link confirms the sign-up and opens the welcome privilege.
preheader: One click, and the Maison’s letter is yours.

lien.description: The confirmation link, valid for seven days

privilege.description: Filled in when this click opens the welcome privilege

blocs.texte:
Hello,

Thank you for wishing to receive the Maison’s letter. To confirm your sign-up, open this link: {lien}
This click also opens your welcome privilege: 10% off your first piece for 14 days, taken off automatically when you pay with this email address.
The link stays valid for seven days. If you did not ask for anything, simply ignore this email: you will receive nothing else.

See you soon,
the Maison Awrea Paris
